profile.summary: Oakland Natives Give Back is an Oakland nonprofit founded in 2008. It runs programs aimed at educational equity and at reducing chronic absenteeism, including backpack and school supply distributions, the Girls Equity Movement leadership program, and an attendance challenge with cash incentives.
